final_message:
All 5 tests in `tests/test_slugify.py` are now passing. The issue was that the `build/lib/src/slugify.py` file (which pytest imports due to its path configuration) had two bugs:

1. The regex `[^a-z0-9]` only matched single non-alphanumeric characters, so multiple spaces or punctuation were replaced with multiple hyphens instead of being collapsed into one.
2. Trailing punctuation was not being removed, leaving trailing hyphens in the output.

The fix changed the regex to `[^a-z0-9]+` and added `.strip("-")` to properly handle consecutive special characters and trailing punctuation.
